Pairwise intersecting means intersections of whole approval sets, not every individual component pair.

Define L,R,B,C of a component I as the numbers of other components covering just its left endpoint, just its right endpoint, both endpoints, or lying in its interior. Each voter meets every other voter, so the sum over its two components of L+R+B+C is at least n-1. Summing gives n(n-1)≤Σ(L+R+B+C). A containing pair contributes once to B at the inner interval and once to C at the outer, hence ΣB=ΣC.

No point is in more than a intervals: a voter's own components are disjoint. Initial endpoint capacities are Σ(L+B)≤2n(a-1) and Σ(R+B)≤2n(a-1). Order the 2n left endpoints. n(n-1) ≤ 4n(a-1)-a(a-1) = (4n-a)(a-1).
